title: Design: No Charge on New Work Order shows Category and Original work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have an invoiced work order of the regular customer, made for this test.
  • Start on Work Orders.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-07-02e-new-work-order-no-charge-ticked.png, iwo-happy-20-20-new-work-order-no-charge-category-original.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick the regular customer.
  3. Tick No Charge.
  4. Pick Warranty in Category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The No Charge checkbox shows at the bottom.

Step 3:

  • A required select "Category *" appears under the checkbox, empty.

Step 4:

  • The select "Original work order" appears under it, listing the customer's invoiced and closed work orders (number, date, first line) and "Not in ShopView" under Other.
  • Its helper reads "Which earlier work order this job comes from, or Not in ShopView, and the line on it. The line sets the original technician for the comeback and warranty numbers. Optional here, required at Close."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R2: “Ticking it reveals the required select "Category" listing the active No Charge categories, empty by default; Save is refused with the field message "Pick a category" until one is picked.”
